scope: Separate G3 Node compatibility addendum: the same two previously unsupported upstream candidates, no replacement search. Original G3 remains 4/6.

sandbox_policy.source: read-only named volume; separate bounded scratch and offline dependencies

flatten-recursive.acceptance: Exact unchanged historical file hashes, pinned image/capsule, original Mocha argv, exit 0 and 2 passing tests; actual Docker policy verified and cleanup confirmed.

flatten-for.acceptance: Exact unchanged historical file hashes, pinned image/capsule, original Mocha argv, exit 0 and 2 passing tests; actual Docker policy verified and cleanup confirmed.

procedure.order: For each case, validate fresh reference-plan positive/negative controls, execute upstream reference, validate alternative-plan controls, execute authored alternative. Inspect reference/alternative outputs before formal scoring. Then flatten-recursive twice followed by flatten-for twice.
procedure.stop: No automatic retries. Retain every attempt and unknown POST; resume only the same known handle. Stop a semantic mismatch for investigation, never rerun until green. A single separately labelled infrastructure recovery requires an additive record; no expectation or candidate change.
procedure.approval: Fresh exact-plan flags and fresh bound control runs under the owner-delegated task authorization, after reviewing the concrete prepared IDs. No original G3 approval/validation is reused; no separate human UI approval or semantic review is claimed.
procedure.success: Both named controls behave as declared, base tests are ready, reference and authored-alternative observations satisfy all five original assertions. Each genuine candidate runs twice in distinct ordinary/independent environments. Compare exact repeat observations. Failures and ambiguity remain visible.
procedure.interpretation: Existing validated application statuses only; an ordinary failure is not an additional detection. Controls, references, authored alternatives, base preflights and repeats are excluded from unique genuine-candidate counts.

limitations: Retrospective public tasks; original fixes and discussions were read; no blind or held-out claim.
The two candidates share a recursive-flattening contract and differ in historical base; performance is not evaluated.
Exact finite JSON calls only. Five fixed assertions cover a small dense-array domain, not universal correctness.
Upstream reference overlaps the scored implementation; authored alternatives are controls, not independent genuine submissions.
Historical dependency range is ^1.0.0 without a lock; 1.0.0 is our explicit compatible pin, not a claim about the author's installed version.

Combined distinct coverage joins the original four formal Python candidates with these two Node candidates; original G3 statuses and evidence stay unchanged. Different image and intake policy are explicit.
G4 remains on hold; no broad false-positive or AI-agent accuracy claim.
